description: Claude's proposed starter sources for each industry (Milestone 2B). Every entry starts as proposed: missions read none of them until the owner approves it in AI Operations > Sources. Each was chosen from general knowledge of the organization and its public website, and none has been read yet. An empty industries list means the source serves every industry. A match is a domain (subdomains included) or an address prefix.
